subject: Re: R.e. Encord - nice to meet + reschedule
text:
Hi Kat, 

 It was great meeting you too. We're enthusiastic about moving this forward. 

 Our developer lead has addressed the questions, as follows: 

 "1. Do your developers have models in progress they'd want to plug in via SDK, or would you be using our off-the-shelf models (like SAM 3) for automated pre-labelling?  

No, we’ll be using our own models via SDK.  

 2. Are you planning to have your team review and approve the automated labels, or is full automation the goal? 

 To make sure we're on the same page, we're looking to contract Encord's annotation service, so the labelling workload would sit entirely with your team. In-house annotation isn't something we're set up to do at this scale. 

 We'd expect all labels to go through a human review on your side before delivery and sign-off at the end. 

 If deliverables come in below the agreed quality bar, we'd of course expect those to be addressed before final acceptance — so it would be helpful to know a bit about your QA process upfront, just so we can make sure we're aligned before moving forward. 

 3. How many people would need platform access - for reviewing/annotating and for project setup? 

 We'll need two (2) seats, both with full access. 

 One additional point worth confirming before we move forward: we'd expect the complete annotated dataset: Images, frames, and/or video, plus labels for 100% of the contracted volume, to be delivered in a standard open format (COCO JSON, YOLO, or Pascal VOC), with full ownership transferring to us on delivery and no restrictions on downstream use, including for training commercial models. If there are any export limitations or format constraints on your end, it would be helpful to know about those upfront." 

 Looking forward to your confirmation on the above. 

 All the best, 

 Elias
